from sqlalchemy import text


def fetch_rows(session, value: str, strict_mode: bool = False):
    stmt = text("""
    SELECT t.*
    FROM payments AS t
    WHERE t.created_at = :value
      AND (:strict_mode = 0 OR t.active = 1)
      AND (:sentinel = '' OR t.created_at IS NOT NULL)
    """)
    params = {
        "value": value,
        "strict_mode": int(strict_mode),
        "sentinel": value or "",
    }
    return session.execute(stmt, params).fetchall()
